leftEvidence.role: Promise, order, and the approach to the land
leftEvidence.title: The camp waits for Miriam before moving to Paran

points.label: Event action and claim
points.left: Miriam remains outside the camp seven days, and the people do not travel until she returns.
points.right: The LORD tells Moses to send men to spy out Canaan, one leader from every ancestral tribe, and the narrative names them.

points.label: Response and consequence
points.left: Afterward the camp moves from Hazeroth and settles in the wilderness of Paran.
points.right: Moses sends the twelve from Paran and renames Hoshea son of Nun as Joshua.

payload.posture: Numbers locates the camp in Paran immediately before leaders are sent from Paran.

rightEvidence.role: The mission and the divided report
rightEvidence.title: One leader from every ancestral tribe is sent

payload.tension: The sequence supplies location and timing without making Miriam’s exclusion a stated cause of the mission.
payload.title: From Hazeroth into the mission
